fy_transform.vibration_generation: IAAFT-like surrogate from original Fy high-frequency residual: same amplitude distribution and nearly same spectrum, but different phase/pattern.
fy_transform.note: Only Fy was changed. Fx/Fz/Torque channels, timestamps, sequences and status are preserved. Fy starts and ends at zero, and the 9-16 s interval has a new waveform with mean about +8 N.
